claim: Enexis says a GTO leaves individual connections in place, gives the group one transport contract, and needs an EMS to distribute capacity and remain within group capacity.
Enexis says it is working with ten business parks on GTO development and expects broader customer availability from 2027.

In a decision announced on 19 July 2024, ACM said regional operators could offer time-block-bound transport contracts from 1 April 2025, while the transmission-network duration-bound form provides maximum transport use at least 85% of the time.

claim: Stedin says a GTO group is jointly responsible for not exceeding capacity, needs an EMS, and can use its Netburenscan to identify companies on the same grid section.

ACM's GTO code decision says each breach is reported to the group's representative; after two or more breaches the operator may suspend transport rights, and a further breach after remedial measures may ultimately cause the right to lapse.
ACM's GTO code decision sets no civil-liability terms because ACM says it lacks power to regulate civil agreements between connected parties or groups and grid operators.
